partial_policy: Any partial, ambiguous, cropped, hidden, or split-across-scales evidence is fail.
scale_policy: Respect each target gate review_scale and inspect the native image plus supplied thumbnail. All required components must coexist in this one image.
prompt_blindness: Do not inspect prompts, candidate packs, source-arm folders, self-reviews, coordinator mapping, or other images.

common_gates.description: The original adult fictional woman's visible facial structure, long dark wavy hair, and restrained natural makeup remain observably guided by the supplied portrait; this is appearance continuity only, not identity verification.
The human subject reads unambiguously as an adult original fictional woman.
Visible human face, hands, and body anatomy remain photographically coherent enough for the scene.
The human subject's specified field, laboratory, conservation, survey, or ecology action and its immediate scene consequence are visually readable rather than a passive portrait.
